notes.title: Tag Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*]A new game mode has been added called tag where one person is chosen randomly to be in and has to try to tag other players before dying because the monster will only go after whoever is in. There is also an optional mode for tag called build up tag where you are still in after you tag someone else.
[*]Added ability to flashbang humans if option is enabled.
[*] Bug fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Up Close and Personal + Music Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Added new optional game alteration called Up Close and Personal where the monster's footsteps and other sounds have a lot less range, but the player can run slightly faster than the monster. This means the monster will be able to sneak up on you more often, but you will have a chance to get away.
[*]Added more scary elements including music.
[*]Bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Halloween Update
notes.content:
Horror Royale's biggest update yet includes a new map - Space Station and a new monster - The Imposter. 

Space Station brings many new textures and assets which help make it the most detailed map in the game so far. 

The Imposter takes the appearance of a human and chooses to reveal its true form when it feels like it.
